body:
Turtle: Leather armor, iron  chestplate, iron sword
Abilities: take only 50% knockback, slowness 1

Storm: Leather armor, stone sword
Abilities: 20% chance of striking lightning when you hit someone (lightning does stone sword damage to anyone withing 3-4 blocks), get speed 1 for 5 seconds after every kill

Level: Idk you guys suggest something

replies.author: andee88
replies.body:
Turtle has no drawbacks from warrior so i think it should have slowness OR be at a much higher level than some other kits (like archer)

Storm seems pretty good but the chance for lightning should be lower, but thats just imo since 20% seems too high for me

Turtle: ~32
Storm: ~28

replies.author: Stimulating
replies.body: i think you should look into maybe making some of the armour on turtle gold instead of iron chestplate, as that would be a bit broke imo. i'd say make the armour value a little under full leather and iron chestplate. Maybe even remove leather helmets or boots? I understand the slowness is there. But not all players, especially casual ones, can exploit that well with strafes.
